title: Example CR suite: Direct LOA, DP to LOA and Quotation/Tender (structure demo, not a real CR)
notes: Shows how a CR suite is built: each scenario names a registry flow, where DATA PREP stops (prepare.until: a step ID or a status) and where EXECUTION ends (execute.until). Copy tests/cr-suites/_TEMPLATE to tests/cr-suites/<CR no>/ for a real CR, then npm run suites:gen.

scenarios.title: Desk Officer verifies a Direct LOA (one-off services)
scenarios.expected: LOA completed: DB LA 62506 Letter of Acceptance Completed / Surat Setuju Terima Telah Selesai
scenarios.manual: Log in as the Desk Officer the Verify Manual LOA task is assigned to (npm run qa -- doc-status shows it), open the LOA from My Task, verify it.

scenarios.title: Supplier acknowledges a Direct LOA (one-off product)
scenarios.expected: DB LA 62505 Pending Verification of Acknowledgement Receipt's Letter Of Acceptance

scenarios.title: Prepare the LOA from an approved DP Request Note, supplier accepts, DO verifies
scenarios.expected: DB LA 62506; the SQ goes to 60853 and the RN to 60703 Completed

scenarios.title: Quotation/Tender: Desk Officer prepares the documents after the specification sign-off
scenarios.expected: DB QT 60030 Pending BPK Approval (or 60005 when no BPK approval is needed)
scenarios.manual: QT steps are manual for now: the run stops at each with instructions; reconcile it as done and resume, and the SIT database confirms the status.
